name: P2X - Power-to-X – EXTENDED
summary:
Power-to-X! is the extended version of our app and is ideal if you have more time. 
- Runtime of approx. 45 minutes
- Non-linear user guidance
- More interactions, Easter eggs, and more detailed information
- Includes the Fischer-Tropsch synthesis in the lab
